appearance_facts.fact: The orange-red wedge is the largest region on the page, extending from the 12 o'clock position clockwise to approximately the 4:30 position.
The dark red wedge is the second-largest region, extending from approximately the 4:30 position to the 7:30 position.
The pale yellow wedge is a medium-sized region, extending from approximately the 7:30 position to the 9:30 position.
The light orange wedge is the smallest region, extending from approximately the 9:30 position to the 12 o'clock position.
